```lean
intro h
split
· intro h1
  cases h1 with h2 h3
  · exact ⟨1, by rw [h2, pow_zero]⟩
  · rcases h3 with h4|h5
    · have h6 := h4
      have h7 := h5
      have h8 := pow_inj (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp h4) h6 h7
      exact ⟨h8, h4⟩
· intro h1
  cases h1 with h2 h3
  · exact Or.inl (And.intro h2 h3)
  · rcases h3 with h4|h5
    · have h6 := h4
      have h7 := h5
      have h8 := pow_inj (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp h4) h6 h7
      exact Or.inr (And.intro h4 h8)
```
